I need to open 20 doors efficiently. Let me start by examining the doors and looking for keys or objects in the environment.

examine stisk_1

I have shpers, kultmas, and lakneds. I also have vralk numbers from the doors. Let me try combining items to make keys, or try using items directly on doors.

combine shper kultma

I see - the vulkdub yields vralk numbers, but doesn't open the door directly. I need to figure out what opens the doors. The doors had vralk numbers fall out when I searched them. Let me try using a lakned on a door, or combining differently.

use vulkdub stisk_2

Interesting! The vulkdub yields sequential vralk numbers. Earlier stisk_1 gave vralk_19 when searched, but now gives vralk_1. The vralk numbers might be keys needed to open specific doors. Let me think...

When I searched the doors, vralk numbers fell out. Maybe I need to use those vralk numbers on matching doors. But I don't seem to hold the vralk items directly.

Let me try using the vulkdub on all doors to collect vralk items, then use them. But first let me check if vralk_1 (just obtained) can open a door.

use vulkdub stisk_3

The vulkdub yields sequential vralk numbers (vralk_1, vralk_2, vralk_3...). Maybe I need vralk_N to open stisk_N. Let me try using vralk_3 on stisk_3.

examine vralk_3

vralk_N opens stisk_N. I need to use the vulkdub on each door to get the matching vralk, then use it. I already have vralk_1 and vralk_2. Let me use them first, then continue.

use vralk_1 stisk_1
